note: Inputs for an ILLUSTRATIVE WACC scenario for AstraZeneca. Each was read on 2026-10-26, checked against its source by the author (David confirmed on 2026-10-26 that he checked them) and matched by an external AI-assisted check the same day. They are dated estimates, not AstraZeneca-specific market measurements.

rf.label: Risk-free rate (10-year US Treasury yield)
rf.note: AstraZeneca reports and generates cash flows in US dollars, so a dollar rate is used.

erp.label: Equity risk premium (implied, mature market)
erp.source: Damodaran implied ERP, 2025 year-end row (published January 2026)
erp.note: Not an October 2026 estimate; other sources use roughly 5% to 6%.

unlevBeta.label: Unlevered beta, global pharmaceuticals
unlevBeta.source: Damodaran betas by sector, global, January 2026 (1,260 firms)
unlevBeta.note: An industry estimate, not AstraZeneca's own beta. The same table lists a cash-corrected beta of 1.00.

de.label: Target debt-to-equity
de.note: Industry average used as a target structure; AstraZeneca's own market-value weights are not used (no bundled share price).

tax.label: Marginal tax rate (debt shield and relevering)
tax.note: AstraZeneca's FY2025 effective rate was 17.5% (2,169 / 12,402); the DCF's operating-tax assumption of 18% is unchanged so the comparison isolates WACC.

spread.label: Credit spread over the risk-free rate
spread.source: AstraZeneca FY2025 20-F: long-term ratings Moody's A1 and S&P A+; Damodaran's January 2026 spread for A1/A+
spread.note: A rating-based proxy, not a measured current AstraZeneca bond spread.
